notes: Reference cassette: img-without-alt finding. Streaming explain (3 chunks) + structured fix.

chunks: This image element has no alt attribute, so screen readers will announce its filename instead.
That leaves users without sight unable to know what the image shows.
Add alt="Brief description" for meaningful images, or alt="" for purely decorative ones.

change.value: A grey tabby cat sitting on a windowsill

manifest.summary: Set alt="A grey tabby cat sitting on a windowsill" on the img element.
manifest.rationale: The image source suggests it shows a cat. A short descriptive alt text helps screen-reader users understand the image without overwhelming them.
